title: Extraction meets Distillation - cryptanalytic techniques to recover parameters from a Deep Neural Network
abstract: arXiv:2610.33671v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study fully connected neural-network reconstruction by combining cryptanalytic weight-direction extraction with learning from predicted labels. We adapt a ReLU extraction implementation to Leaky ReLU, compare sign-search methods, and estimate biases and output layers. We prove conditional bounds for direction recovery with approximate prefixes, preservation of local distance votes, prediction changes from aligned parameter errors, and sign selection with independent scoring data. We also specify exact row restoration and distinguish its guarantee from that of gradient masking. The experiments evaluate assisted extraction, with privileged access to gradients, hidden activations, and victim parameters, followed by label-based reconstruction. Across eight search seeds on the largest synthetic architecture, Leaky ReLU recovers 51--57 neurons in the deepest hidden layer, while ReLU recovers none. This advantage does not hold uniformly ac

translated_title: 提取遇上蒸馏——从深度神经网络中恢复参数的密码分析技术
translated_abstract: 我们研究了全连接神经网络的重建问题，将密码分析中的权重方向提取与基于预测标签的学习相结合。我们将ReLU提取实现适配到Leaky ReLU，比较了符号搜索方法，并估计了偏置和输出层。我们证明了若干条件性界：基于近似前缀的方向恢复、局部距离投票的保持、对齐参数误差引起的预测变化，以及使用独立评分数据的符号选择。我们还明确规定了精确行恢复，并将其保证与梯度掩码区分开来。实验评估了辅助提取（即特权访问梯度、隐藏激活值和受害者参数），随后进行基于标签的重建。在最大合成架构上跨八个搜索种子的实验中，Leaky ReLU在最深隐藏层恢复了51至57个神经元，而ReLU一个也未能恢复。这一优势并不总是普遍成立。
tldr: 该论文将密码分析中的权重方向提取技术与基于标签的蒸馏学习相结合，用于恢复全连接深度神经网络的参数，并证明Leaky ReLU提取在最深隐藏层可恢复51至57个神经元，而ReLU提取则完全失效。
en_tdlr: This paper combines cryptanalytic weight-direction extraction with label-based distillation to reconstruct fully connected deep neural networks, demonstrating that Leaky ReLU extraction recovers 51-57 neurons in the deepest hidden layer while ReLU extraction recovers none.
